module: Flowgraph node "Controls Reset" (category logic, event). Lets flow through when the player presses Reset. When it is used, the default freeroam reset no longer happens (data.blocksOnResetGameplay = true). Pins: flow (input), flow (pulse output) and value (hidden bool).
notes: Records an event in the flowgraph log (logEvent) on each press.
Adds a "Reset" button to the game context interface (onGatherGameContextUiButtons), active only if the node is in an active state and was used in the current frame.

_afterTrigger.desc: Resets self.reset to false after triggering.

onResetGameplay.desc: Hook called by extensions.hook("onResetGameplay"): stores the press.

onGatherGameContextUiButtons.desc: Hook: adds to results the button {id='controlsReset', label='Reset', order=0, active}.

work.desc: Sets flow and value to true one frame after a reset, otherwise to false.
